# Wikibooks Cookbook recipe adaptations

The twenty Chinese recipe entries in `src/cooking/world-catalog-data.json` are
adapted from English Wikibooks Cookbook contributors. Each entry links its fixed
original revision and page history for author attribution. The exact revisions,
original wikitext SHA-256 digests and local dataset digest are in `provenance.json`.

Copyright belongs to the respective Wikibooks contributors. These translations,
editorial changes, names, ingredient lists and recipe sections are distributed
under **Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International**:
<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>. The complete license is in
`LICENSE`. This data is excluded from the program's MIT license. The existing
HowToCook dataset retains its separate Unlicense provenance.

AI-assisted Chinese translation and editing are identified in the recipe UI.
The adaptation omits images, introductions, nutrition estimates and unrelated
variants, groups preparation and cooking instructions, and discloses specific
corrections or omissions in recipe notes. Missing serving counts and total times
remain unknown. The original units are retained rather than inventing household
utensil conversions. Sources are provided as-is, without warranties, under the
license's disclaimer. Wikibooks and its contributors do not endorse LifeOS.

The attribution and reuse policy is documented by Wikibooks at
<https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Wikibooks:Copyrights>. The dataset and its
attributions remain available in source independently of the authenticated
personal application. No upstream media or personal cooking records are included.
